title: Sleep Apnea and Periodic Breathing
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the double loop index (DLI) threshold with optimal sensitivity and specificity. The investigators hypothesize that the DLI gives a better reflection of the pathophysiology of the disease than the apnea-hypopnea-index (AHI).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected sleep apnea syndrome
* \> 18 yr
* Outpatient
* Able and willing to use the necessary equipment for registration of nasal pressure and O2 saturation at home

Exclusion Criteria:

* hospitalized patients
* \< 18 yr
* Not able to use the necessary equipment
study_population: Outpatients suspected for sleep apnea syndrome
